# QuadB Technologies

> Founder-led AI product engineering and fractional CTO leadership for funded startups and SMEs.

QuadB Technologies is a registered partnership based in Ludhiana, Punjab, India. Vinayak Kalra is represented publicly as Founder and Technical Lead and works directly across product strategy, architecture and delivery.

Verified company facts:
- Operating since 2016
- 200+ projects delivered
- Work across 10+ countries
- Public email: vinayak.kalra@quadbtech.com
